build_systems.name: dbt (databricks)
build_systems.notes: Project profile is the literal dbt_databricks (the bundle job's dbt task cannot find a profile named through env_var()). In an Intent Studio writes that profile with one target, databricks_sandbox (the Ephemeral catalog and the Intent's mirror schema); profiles.yml holds the Domain's prod target for a run outside Studio. The bundle job's dbt task uses the profile Databricks generates from its warehouse, catalog and schema.

build_systems.name: dlt
build_systems.notes: One pipeline notebook per source, ingestion/<name>_pipeline.ipynb, from the plugin's Databricks template; it loads through databricks_files_api() from vibedata-dlt-databricks-notebook. config.toml names no catalog or warehouse: dlt refuses a credentials section there. A sandbox run passes the Ephemeral catalog and warehouse in the notebook's dlt_env widget; the job passes its dlt_env variable, which defaults to the catalog and warehouse it is deployed with.

build_systems.name: Databricks bundle
build_systems.notes: A Declarative Automation Bundle whose jobs are orchestration/*.job.yml. The plugin's validate-job.py checks it; customer CI/CD deploys the prod target.

test_frameworks.name: dbt tests
test_frameworks.scope: Generic tests in _*.yml, singular tests in transformation/tests/, unit tests in _unit_tests.yml beside the models they cover (intermediate, agg, ops).

test_frameworks.name: pytest
test_frameworks.scope: Offline unit tests for ingestion, orchestration, and the two maps.

applications.name: nyc-taxi-databricks
applications.description: NYC taxi analytics over real TLC trip records for 2024-01 to 2024-03, plus two simulated source systems (fleet operations and master data). Every layer is a schema in the Domain's Unity Catalog production catalog (VD_DOMAIN_DATABRICKS_CATALOG).

bronze.notes: TLC trips and zone lookup, verbatim.

seeds.notes: Analyst-owned banding tables, loaded by dbt seed into their own schema; internal, like staging.

semantic_exclusions.reason: Not a star member: a HAVING floor (at least 25 trips) keeps only well-populated origin-destination pairs, so it is a filtered population, not the full set of trips; a model over it would mislead.
Unpivot of fare components into one row per component: summing its measures across trips fans out, so it cannot be a fact in a star.
No join key into any star: no fact carries a fare-regime key, so it cannot be a conformed dimension.

tlc.description: NYC TLC yellow and green trips and the zone lookup, fetched from the public TLC site.

ops.description: Fleet operator's platform, generated from the yellow trips.

mdm.description: Master-data platform: zones, vendors, payment methods, rate plans, regimes, boroughs, points of interest, calendar, weather.

ingestion.description: dlt pipelines (one per source), their source code under sources/, resource docs under docs/, and .dlt/config.toml.

orchestration.description: The nyc_taxi_refresh Lakeflow job (the three pipeline notebooks in parallel, then dbt build), included by databricks.yml at the repository root. Authored by the plugin's generating-orchestration; no schedule is committed.

staging.description: Tables: one per source table, renamed and typed, with same-row derivations. Also holds _sources.yml.

intermediate.description: Business logic and joins: conformed trips, enrichment, fare components, quality flags, zone attributes, status intervals, shift occupancy and economics. Unit tests in _unit_tests.yml.

core.description: Facts and conformed dimensions, plus the semantic model (_semantic.yml).

finance.description: Revenue marts. Apply the billable rule (ADR 0003): filter on `fct_trip.is_billable`, inside the report window.

ops.description: Fleet-operations marts: driver scorecard, vehicle utilisation, trip quality scorecard.

macros.description: trip_natural_key (the only definition of trip_key), report window, finance helpers, utc_date (timestamps.sql), the plugin's generate_schema_name (the Intent's prefix in a sandbox) and source_defer.sql, which resolves source() to the Intent's own load when it holds one, else the Domain's table.

python_tests.description: pytest tests for ingestion, orchestration wiring and the maps.

decisions.description: ADRs, including the standing business answers.

designs.description: Design records per model and pipeline.

requirements.description: Requirements, one file per intent at artifact_paths.requirement; plans and verifications go to artifact_paths.plan and artifact_paths.verification when first written.

conventions.description: Operator conventions as skills (OpenHands lists each one): naming, style, testing, dlt, and what goes in context, ADRs and design records.

setup.description: Repo maintenance documents (requirements, work plan, conventions inventory, skill changes, data provenance). Not for ingestion or transformation tasks; not maintained by build agents.

reviews.description: Review outputs (onboarding, security, performance and others) whose findings are triaged: intent, proposal, declined or deferred.

proposals.description: Optional proposals for major functional or design items that need discussion before they become intents.

key_directories.orchestration/: Lakeflow job files (databricks.yml at the root includes them)
key_directories.docs/setup/: Repo maintenance: the port's requirements and plans, the data-provenance notes, the skill changes it implies, how it keeps up with the upstream repos and how to seed the Domain. Not for ingestion or transformation tasks; do not read it for them, and do not maintain it.
key_directories.docs/review/: Review findings for triage. Not read during build tasks.
key_directories.docs/proposal/: Proposals that become intents. Read one only when the intent links to it.

notes_for_agents.startup: Read this file first. AGENTS.md says how to work; the skills in .agents/skills/ hold the conventions.
notes_for_agents.reporting_window: report_start and report_end are dbt vars in dbt_project.yml and define the business reporting window. They are not a sampling control.
notes_for_agents.synthetic_data: ops_raw and mdm_raw are simulated. TLC trips are real.
notes_for_agents.trip_key: Produced only by the trip_natural_key macro. The operator source carries natural columns, not the key.
notes_for_agents.domain_catalog: The Domain's production catalog (VD_DOMAIN_DATABRICKS_CATALOG) holds every layer. Only a release writes it; an Intent writes its own schemas in the Domain's shared Ephemeral catalog, each named with the Intent's prefix (VD_EPHM_SCHEMA_PREFIX, ephm__<domain>__<intent>__), and reads production by three-part name. A ref() to a model the Intent did not build resolves to the Domain under --defer --state /cache/prod-target, whenever /cache/prod-target/manifest.json exists.
notes_for_agents.dlt_environment: Each pipeline is a Databricks notebook, ingestion/<name>_pipeline.ipynb, from the plugin's databricks/templates/dlt-pipeline.ipynb, loading through databricks_files_api() from vibedata-dlt-databricks-notebook. In an Intent, run it on serverless compute with the plugin's run_notebook.py (databricks/dlt.md § Sandbox run, § Full load), which passes the Ephemeral catalog, warehouse and the Intent's prefix in dlt_env; never set them by hand or commit them. dlt lands column names in lower case.
notes_for_agents.new_source: A new source mirrors an existing entry in `sources`: create every artifact it lists (module, config section, pipeline notebook, resource docs, tests, design record). Mirror `tlc` for a downloaded file source. Then add its notebook as a task ahead of the dbt task in orchestration/nyc_taxi_refresh.job.yml, run the plugin's validate-job.py until it exits 0 (the job cannot run in a sandbox: every layer sets +schema, so its release run proves it), and register it in test-map.json.
notes_for_agents.setup_docs: docs/setup/ is repo maintenance. Do not read or maintain it for ingestion or transformation work.
notes_for_agents.reviews_and_proposals: docs/review/ holds review findings for triage; do not read it for build tasks. Read a docs/proposal/ file only when the intent's requirement links to it.
notes_for_agents.dbt_sources: dbt sources name their schema and, as database, "{{ env_var('VD_DOMAIN_DATABRICKS_CATALOG', target.database) }}"; never write a catalog name into _sources.yml. macros/source_defer.sql reads the Intent's own <prefix><schema> table in the Ephemeral catalog when the Intent loaded it, and the Domain's table otherwise. Every layer sets +schema:, so a sandbox builds <prefix>staging, <prefix>core and so on. dbt runs in the sandbox use Studio's profile dbt_databricks, target databricks_sandbox.
notes_for_agents.artifact_paths: Every artifact location is declared here: requirement, plan, verification and case_record per intent, design records per model, dlt pipeline, orchestration item (a Lakeflow job file) or area. The plugin names an intent's artifacts; this map places them.
